description: Source code for pandas-on-Spark Series datetime-related functions and methods, including properties for date/time components, ISO calendar, and formatting, as well as methods for normalization, rounding, and locale-based name retrieval.

classes.name: DatetimeMethods
classes.description: Class providing date/time properties and methods for pandas-on-Spark Series, including extraction of date/time components, ISO calendar, and formatting.

methods.name: date
methods.description: Returns a Series of python datetime.date objects representing the date part of Timestamps.

methods.name: time
methods.description: Not implemented, raises NotImplementedError.

methods.name: timetz
methods.description: Not implemented, raises NotImplementedError.

methods.name: year
methods.description: Extracts the year component from the datetime Series.

methods.name: month
methods.description: Extracts the month component from the datetime Series.

methods.name: day
methods.description: Extracts the day of month from the datetime Series.

methods.name: hour
methods.description: Extracts the hour component from the datetime Series.

methods.name: minute
methods.description: Extracts the minute component from the datetime Series.

methods.name: second
methods.description: Extracts the second component from the datetime Series.

methods.name: microsecond
methods.description: Extracts the microsecond component from the datetime Series.

methods.name: nanosecond
methods.description: Not implemented, raises NotImplementedError.

methods.name: isocalendar
methods.description: Calculates ISO calendar components (year, week, day) for the Series.

methods.name: dayofweek
methods.description: Returns the day of the week with Monday=0, Sunday=6.

methods.name: weekday
methods.description: Alias for dayofweek.

methods.name: dayofyear
methods.description: Returns the day of the year.

methods.name: quarter
methods.description: Returns the quarter of the date.

methods.name: is_month_start
methods.description: Indicates whether the date is the first day of the month.

methods.name: is_month_end
methods.description: Indicates whether the date is the last day of the month.

methods.name: is_quarter_start
methods.description: Indicates whether the date is the first day of a quarter.

methods.name: is_quarter_end
methods.description: Indicates whether the date is the last day of a quarter.

methods.name: is_year_start
methods.description: Indicates whether the date is the first day of a year.

methods.name: is_year_end
methods.description: Indicates whether the date is the last day of a year.

methods.name: is_leap_year
methods.description: Boolean indicator if the date belongs to a leap year.

methods.name: daysinmonth
methods.description: Number of days in the month.

methods.name: days_in_month
methods.description: Alias for daysinmonth.

methods.name: tz_localize
methods.description: Not implemented, raises NotImplementedError.

methods.name: tz_convert
methods.description: Not implemented, raises NotImplementedError.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Converts times to midnight, removing time component.

methods.name: strftime
methods.description: Formats the Series as strings according to the specified date format.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Rounds the datetime Series to the specified frequency.

methods.name: floor
methods.description: Floors the datetime Series to the specified frequency.

methods.name: ceil
methods.description: Ceils the datetime Series to the specified frequency.

methods.name: month_name
methods.description: Returns the month names of the Series, optionally locale-based.

methods.name: day_name
methods.description: Returns the day names of the Series, optionally locale-based.
